data_flow: common episode -> observation/public original candidates -> public_facts -> explicit MemoryDriver.resolve(public_state, public_criteria) -> PilotMemoryView and receipt -> ContextBuilder.build(memory_view=..., retrieval_receipt=...) -> durable DECISION_READY context -> request ledger/native Choice -> SELECTED -> MONITORED -> original commit or stop
privacy: driver never receives full task, arrival stream, witness, current future boxes, PCT diagnostics or evaluation metrics; source group is a private exclusion dependency, not a score feature
recovery: complete query/view/body/receipt persisted in authoritative checkpoint before sending; saved DECISION_READY/SELECTED/MONITORED/COMMITTED is reused without driver/candidate dispatch; malformed/missing core saved fields or changed snapshot/config refuse. Separate trace files are exact copies of durable context.
standard_validation: final checkpoint reconstructs each saved public event once; every phase is proven as a prefix and correctly restricted projection of already validated final events. No numerical reassessment or commit; source/rule/snapshot/read-only algebra checked.
identity: context/binding/body/mapping/query/retrieval/view/snapshot/ledger/selection/monitor freeze together; ledger binds the complete per-job/global budget and config identities
empty_and_singleton: T/E empty hits remain assigned methods with explicit empty views; singleton may have a hit but has no model body/send and no actual request injection
limits: same parent retrieval features, score/threshold/tie, whole-source exclusion, 1 complete entry, char/UTF8 limits and 5-metric result budget; no update to parent memory, history projection or physical algorithm
architecture: reuse common _run_job, episode, native parser, RequestLedger/OrderLedger and export_decisions optional record builder; no A/B script concatenation or second order engine
previous_versions: v6 no-memory, v7 T, v8 E and their closed schemas are retained; new config/context/bundle/selection/checkpoint/schema routes only for v9
first_task_gate: close and standard-validate all three methods; stop on technical/identity/recovery/metrics/UNKNOWN_SEND/watchdog/cancel; continue on natural or declared range outcomes; at least one confirmed nonempty memory response needed; benefit never determines continuation
final_recommendation: frozen DEFER/REVISE/PROCEED rule; all positive/neutral/degraded/invalid and cost/height effects retained; never require E to win
